title: Moula Moula Hussain Moula
body:
Maula Maula Hussain maula
<<DIVIDER>>
maula maula
allah maula nabi maula
<<MINI>>
sain ali maula hussain maula
<<DIVIDER>>
aayo aahe mahe moharram
haae ghar ghar sadaat jo gham
so game ao gaazia jo parcham
kio sughra akbar jo matam to ke ro andho har insaan maula
<<DIVIDER>>
haan farsh wala ay arsh wala
haay tana the sab we sakhara
wa hussaina hai wa hussaina
tunjho deena the ya ehsaan maula
<<DIVIDER>>
sain ishq maula dil jaan maula
shaan pahenjo imaan maula
maatami ya mehmaan maula
thenji matam pehchaan maula to ta sadke hi jind jaan maula
<<DIVIDER>>
maula tohonjo rozo nihare
karbala te zakhmi de saare
royi royi dil thi pukaare
aayo maula tunjho sahaare
<<DIVIDER>>
har mushkil kar aasaan maula
onjhi maula zawwaar bandi
karbala me duniya achedi
tunjhe dar pe maatam karedi
<<DIVIDER>>
thenjo khaali daaman bharedi
tu asakhyan jo sultaan maula
ha allah allah kahiyo gham bhalaacha
tainjo maula sain ali maula
<<DIVIDER>>
shah bithaai sakhilaal paara
tujhe dar the malum tha rutba
tunjha naukar ha salmaan da
aayi zainab jenh jen sahaare
<<DIVIDER>>
katl theo aa dariya kanaare
waahe ja wa chahi veer haare
haay ghaazi zainab pukaare
hoyo pardan jo nigraan maula
<<DIVIDER>>
haay qaidi sayyad bazaar aaya
shaam waaran patthar wasaaya
haay sharaabin sadma rasaaya
neera rat ja aabid wahaaya
<<DIVIDER>>
sehre bibin ja uryaan maula
yaad aayo qaasim ay akbar
maula tuenjho maasum asghar
kiyan wisre ghaazi dilaawar
<<DIVIDER>>
kal tha maatam jawwaado sarwar
ghar to hujhonto qurbaan maula
<<MINI>>
maula maula maula maula
maula maula hussain maula
